plan.name: Cycle-Phased Strength — 2-Week Intro Block
plan.description: A 2-week introductory strength block phased around a 28-day menstrual cycle. Week 1 falls in the late-follicular window (cycle days ~31-37 relative to last period start 2026-05-01, i.e. programme days 1-7 map to cycle days 31-37 ≈ cycle days 3-9 of the new cycle). Flow days 1-3 of any cycle are protected: no high-intensity work, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping. Outside that window the client is fully cleared for progressive strength training.

goals.name: Build a safe strength foundation
goals.description: Establish movement quality and baseline strength across the main compound patterns before progressing load in later phases.

goals.name: Train in harmony with the menstrual cycle
goals.description: Protect flow days 1-3 from high-intensity and high-intra-abdominal-pressure work; leverage the follicular energy window for progressive overload.

inputs.label: Current cycle day (1 = first day of period)

actions.reason: Cycle days 1-3: replace strength main block with low-intensity mobility and breathwork per GP contraindication.
Low readiness: reduce prescribed load by 20% and cap RPE at 6.

phases.name: Introductory Reconditioning Block
phases.description: Two weeks of technique-first, moderate-load training. Week 1 (programme start 2026-06-01) falls on approximately cycle day 31 of the previous cycle, i.e. cycle day 3 of the new cycle — so Monday is a protected flow-day session. From Tuesday onward the client is in the follicular phase and cleared for progressive work. Week 2 is fully in the follicular/pre-ovulatory window: energy and strength are typically at their monthly peak.

checkpoints.name: End of Intro Block Assessment

measurements.note: Subjective energy and pain levels on flow days vs training days

questions: How did flow-day sessions feel compared to training days?
Were prescribed loads appropriate (RPE on target)?
Any pelvic discomfort during or after training sessions?

notifications.message: Today is a protected flow day. Your session has been swapped to gentle mobility and breathwork. Listen to your body — rest is training too.
You're in your follicular phase — energy and strength are rising. Today's session has a small load increase. Push within your RPE target.
